# v0.6.1 — Charging goals, departure planning and easier setup

Stable release of the integration and app. Changes since **0.5.1**:

- **Charging goals:** optional energy limits in kWh and vehicle charge targets
  in percent, using your existing vehicle integration.
- **Ready for the next trip:** plan charging for a departure selected manually,
  from a calendar or from an optional BavarianData timer. A separate blueprint
  can start your chosen climate action before departure.
- **Losses and costs:** optional charging-loss estimates, fixed or dynamic
  electricity prices, and German Module 2/3 network tariffs with Module 3 import
  and annual refresh.
- **Easier setup and operation:** guided USB/LAN app setup, clearer entities,
  configurable charging waits, cancelable queued changes and optional command
  events. Quieter defaults reduce database traffic; AppArmor protects the app.
- **Fixes:** more reliable heartbeat recovery and reconnects, safer phase
  changes, correct LAN setup and tariff options. Expired departure commands
  cannot execute later while HA is offline.

Keep your existing entry and app data. In service mode, **update the app/service
to 0.6.1 first**, then update the integration in HACS/Marketplace. Older services
do not meet the new minimum. The stable app is published through **#apps** and
also updates existing **#apps-beta** installations. Direct USB/LAN needs no app.
